info.title: dotnet-ai - CodingWithEase AI Capability Providers host
info.description: dotnet-ai: discovers and executes AI Capability Providers exposed by referenced libraries, generating a .dotnet-ai.json manifest + AGENTS.NuGet.md guidance for AI coding agents. Includes an MCP server mode (dotnet-ai mcp) for MCP-native agents.

commands.name: execute
commands.description:
Execute a capability. Args: inline JSON, '-' for stdin,
or --args-file. Returns structured JSON.

commands.name: init
commands.description:
Discover capabilities (recursively across all bin/ folders)
and generate .dotnet-ai.json & AGENTS.NuGet.md

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Display detailed metadata for a package

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all discovered capabilities from the manifest

commands.name: mcp
commands.description:
Serve the manifest's capabilities as MCP tools over stdio
(for MCP-native agents; run 'init' first)

options.name: --path
options.description: Target directory or project file (default: current directory)

options.name: --args-file
options.description: Read execute arguments from a JSON file (avoids shell escaping)

options.name: --package
options.description: Disambiguate when two packages expose the same capability name

options.name: --raw
options.description: execute: print only the generated output (pipe/redirect friendly)

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show help information
Typical agent workflow:
1. dotnet-ai init                      (once per solution, and after rebuilds that change providers)
2. dotnet-ai list --json               (see what is available)
3. dotnet-ai execute CreateGrid --args-file args.json --raw > Grid.razor
